ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance (dark grey/black) across approximately 90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips and sparse high-intensity speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark contiguous pixel mass across central and medial fluke regions; high-contrast white geometric clusters at the terminal left and right tips; sparse white circular point-source clusters (diameter < 10 pixels) distributed across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 135 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/10th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration across the majority of the trailing boundary; higher amplitude jagged peaks located at the extreme distal ends near barnacle clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed outward sweep showing a convex curve emerging from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white high-contrast clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; several discrete circular 'ring' scars located on the right lobe medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal white linear mark on the left lobe originating near the center-medial area; smaller, fainter diagonal linear disruptions on the lower central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular calcified protrusions (consistent with barnacle attachment) at the extreme left and right lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple pinnipeds (sea lions) in the lower foreground; distinct white 'donut' or ring-shaped markings on the right fluke surface.
